{
  "question_intent": "Inquire about fee income growth and cost reduction guidance for 2026 and beyond, and the factors influencing these projections.",
  "main_topics": ["UK fee income growth", "UK cost reduction", "2026 fee income guidance", "2027 cost reduction"],
  "answer_completeness": "Complete",
  "response_stance": "Direct",
  "evidence_level": "High",
  "contains_numeric_evidence": true,
  "contains_forward_guidance": true,
  "narrative_alignment": "Aligned",
  "question_quote": "Two questions on the UK, please. The first one will be on the fee income. I think you're guiding for flat fee income in 2026. So just wondering what is driving this flat guidance and why no growth in 2026? And what kind of growth should we expect from 2027 onwards?",
  "answer_quote": "Thank you. So, we do expect some fee growth in the UK, but that's largely under construction now. So, I'm not anticipating in 2026, which is why we are guiding you to a broadly flat position of circa £250 million each quarter, about £1 billion over the year.",
  "reason": "The answer directly addresses the questions about fee income and cost reduction, providing specific guidance and expectations for 2026 and 2027, with numeric evidence and forward guidance."
}
